basic_info.description: Discover the charm of this Edwardian home at 415 Laguna Street in San Francisco's lively Hayes Valley. This meticulously maintained, fully detached residence features a private entrance, 11+ foot ceilings, decorative moldings, and refinished bamboo floors throughout spacious living areas. Freshly painted interiors highlight two large bedrooms with ample closets; the primary suite includes an en suite bathroom, and a stylish guest bedroom has its own full bathroom. The kitchen boasts new stainless steel appliances, classic cabinetry, and honed granite counters, flowing into a formal dining area perfect for gatherings. Relax by the gas fireplace in the living room or entertain on the large deck. Bright, airy bedrooms and well-designed bathrooms blend timeless appeal with modern comfort. Enjoy new in-unit laundry, a landscaped deck off the primary suite, and private one-car parking. With a Walk Score of 99 and Bike Score of 79, Hayes Valley's vibrant retail, cafes, and dining are steps away, with easy BART and MUNI access. Embrace urban living in this Edwardian gem.
